notes: REVIEW: icon_check flags 32% lost on the light tile: the gorilla's white face meets the tile on its left. That is how Bouncer itself shows the mark on white (its docs' light logo, downloads/bouncer/src4, has the same white face), and there is no brand colour to recolour the face to, so it is left as published; the features (eyes, mustache, mouth) and navy head still read. On dark the full-colour mark passes (0% lost). Bouncer also publishes a dark-mode logo (docs logo-new-dark.svg, downloads/bouncer/src5) that knocks the navy head out to transparent; a derived mark-only copy is at work/agents/b04/alt/bouncer-dark-knockout.svg if the reviewer prefers it for dark. Shape note: the app icon and header logo use this rounded-square head; the marketing site's favicon is a circular ('owal') crop of the same gorilla, available only as PNG.
license: Bouncer brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with Bouncer.
